body: Agreement 3 of 10 from the Dimensional x AuDHD findings comparison (Overlap tab, Jayarr — Dimensional Profile). Matches: JayArr's stated theory (2026-10-24) and the 'why' shut down in childhood (2026-10-29 thread). Nature: consistency between two self-reports (the findings and a self-report app), not confirmation. Levels measured from the app's 5-segment bars.
doc_ref: Jayarr — Dimensional Profile (Claude Docs), Overlap tab
plain: Dimensional's curiosity and stimulation results fit JayArr's theory of a gifted child under-stimulated: Curiosity and Investigating Very high, Love of Learning 83, Stimulation a top-5 value, Novelty Seeking Very high. Consistent with the theory; not evidence of its cause.
status: consistency with JayArr's stated theory (not a filed finding); source call on that theory material: asked, awaiting his answer; content not ruled
